consequence.statement: The schema now rejects v1beta2 HelmChart objects whose status.artifact has no digest.
consequence.remediation: Check that nothing writes v1beta2 HelmChart status with an artifact that has no digest, such as an older controller or a tool that restores status.

original.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 HelmChart CRD schema, status.artifact.digest is now a required field, so HelmChart objects whose status.artifact leaves out a digest are rejected.

decision.reason: The computed diff over the v2.6.4 [ev-782bc47d120d] and v2.7.0 [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] install bundles says status.artifact.digest is newly required in the v1beta2 HelmChart schema and that objects omitting it are rejected. Deterministic validators confirmed this tightening. That supports resource-rejected, and the proposed statement correctly limits rejection to objects whose status.artifact has no digest. Low severity fits a status-only field; confidence is low because the excerpts themselves show no content beyond the diff.
